title: Hindi to Mundari Translation Dataset Corpus
collaboration_reported_by_provider: Indo-German Development Cooperation FAIR Forward - Artificial Intelligence for all; implemented by GIZ on behalf of BMZ

verified_terms: produce/reproduce/share adapted material for NonCommercial purposes
license.caution: License grants copyright/database rights only to the extent held by licensor and explicitly does not license privacy/publicity or other personality rights; open/public availability therefore does not establish participant/translator consent for every downstream use.

deduplication.canonicalization_rule: README, TSV, license, copyright file, mirrors, forks and derivative distributions of the same Karya corpus are manifestations/dependencies of one canonical dataset identity unless independently collected data are demonstrated.
deduplication.independence_rule: Individual sentence pairs are records within one corpus, not independent sources; publications/models using this corpus do not become independent linguistic corroboration merely by reuse.

scope.use: modern Mundari parallel-text/translation evidence after record-level validation
limitations: provider corpus is translation data rather than independently elicited grammar
translation direction/source-text provenance must be retained
sentence-level linguistic claims require record-level validation
cultural claims must not be inferred from translated sentence content

rights_access_consent_culture.access: public GitHub repository; immutable commit verified
rights_access_consent_culture.reuse_basis: KPL BY-NC-SA-FS 1.0, NonCommercial and downstream conditions apply
rights_access_consent_culture.participant_or_translator_consent: not established from README/license inspected in this run; do not infer
rights_access_consent_culture.cultural_sensitivity: translated sentences must be screened before cultural interpretation or publication as cultural evidence

exact_locator_progress.blocker: Connector exposed the immutable Git blob identity but not complete deterministic bytes in a form from which this run could independently compute SHA-256 and recompute all 17,826 rows. Provider count is therefore retained explicitly as provider-reported, not audited-local count.

promotion.reason: No sentence-level evidence is promoted until full immutable TSV bytes are locally hashed, row count/schema are independently recomputed, and exact row locators plus consent/cultural-access status are recorded. The source has nevertheless advanced beyond discovery-only to immutable-commit/blob-level ingestion staging.
required_next_steps: materialize full TSV bytes from immutable upstream commit
recompute row count and malformed/duplicate row statistics
retain Hindi source and Mundari translation together
promote only supported permitted records with exact locators

release_gate_effect: source census and ingestion staging strengthened; controlled evidence counts unchanged pending deterministic full-byte/row audit
